$comment: Project-scoped MCP servers, committed so a clone of this repo gets the same tools. No secret is stored here — ${FIGMA_API_KEY} and ${LINEAR_API_KEY} are expanded from the environment, which is why the real values belong in the gitignored root .env. dev-loop.js calls dotenv.config() and passes process.env down to every agent it spawns, so the keys reach the sub-agents. Approval for these servers is granted by enabledMcpjsonServers in .claude/settings.json.

linear.$comment: Linear's official server. It accepts a raw Linear API key as the bearer token, which avoids a per-machine OAuth login — the agents dev-loop.js spawns run headless and cannot complete an interactive auth flow. Same key dev-loop.js already uses for its direct GraphQL fallback in createLinearClient().
